exposure: preexisting conditions (e.g., diabetes mellitus and hypertension)
Six groups based on the World Health Organization's body mass index classification
finding: Women who were overweight or obese had an increased risk of adverse intrapartum and neonatal outcomes, with the risks increasing with rising body mass index.
mod_finding: Women in the overweight and obese categories were more likely to have an elective or emergency cesarean delivery compared to women with normal BMI.
